items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I said no, I said it was one of those things, when I worked with Jelly I was just a little kid

ctx.x: to get into the darnedest arguments you ever heard and the guys used to sit around there and just egg him on and he would go. So anyway, Jelly said 'Where can I get a drummer?' Well the musicians around the club didn't know me by name, they just said there's a kid over there I think plays drums. So he came over and approached me, 'Do you play drums?' I says yeah. 'Who'd you ever work with?' That's when I started lying you know, because God, Jelly Roll Morton, I'd been reading about him, I looked at Jelly, I said,…

date, which was two hours and maybe two hours prior to the date getting the drums and going to the recording studio. So people come up to me today and say, Well, Cozy, you knew Jelly Roll? I said yeah, I knew him, but I didn't know Jelly that well. And so they said, oh goodness, I know you've got to be ninety years old to know Jelly Roll Morton. I said no, I said it was one of those things, when I worked with Jelly I was just a little kid, you know, and that was my experience with Jelly. Of course after the…
I've got in front of me a Xerox of the discography--
